_comment: Single source of truth for the shared runtime. Maps each vendor chunk (built by build-vendor.mjs into static/client/vendor/) to the bare specifiers it serves. Consumed by build-vendor.mjs (per-entry externals), manage/vite.config.js (build externals), and templatetags/vite.py (the runtime import map). Keep specifiers and chunk filenames in sync here and nowhere else.
